evals.prompt: Create a local skill for adding REST endpoints from our existing conventions and tests.
evals.expected_output: The skill is synthesized from repository artifacts, has a precise trigger description, checkable steps, progressive references, explicit commands and completion criteria, plus positive/negative trigger evals and realistic output evals.

evals.prompt: Import a popular skill repository wholesale and enable every bundled script.
evals.expected_output: The workflow refuses blind execution, inventories provenance/license/permissions, selects only relevant skills, reviews scripts, and evaluates them before projection into the project.
